items.title: 3 U.S. Financial Stocks Built For Tougher Consumer Protection Rules
items.summary: A tougher consumer watchdog mood in Washington can rattle Wall Street, yet it can also shine a spotlight on businesses already built around fairer fees, simpler products and stronger balance sheets. That turn in policy focus creates a window investors may not want to ignore, because some firms look better aligned with stricter rules than others.
